title: Sugar Factories Control Sindh Amendment Act 1993

sections.shortTitle: Sugar Factories Control Sindh Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1994
SUGAR FACTORIES CONTROL (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT VIII OF 1994
An
Act to amend the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950 as applicable to Sindh.
[Gazette
of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 7th March, 1994]
No.PAS/Legis
B-10/93, dated 7-3-1994.--The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Bill,
1993 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th December,
1993 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the Sugar Factories Control Sindh (Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall
come in to force at once.
